svg.title: 016 fog comparison / Reader
svg.desc: Fog treatments W1–W3 are columns. Each labeled row shares one fixture and viewpoint. Story revelations through page 039.
svg.text: FOG-OF-WAR STUDIES — NOT ADOPTED / COLUMNS W1–W3 / OPEN AT FULL SIZE / REVELATIONS THROUGH 039

svg.title: Patchy contest — 016 / The unreachable field — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 016 / The unreachable field, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response dark, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Propositions and observations are pictograms beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: A SINGLE-SOURCED CONFIGURATION ACCOUNT IS NOT ACCESS TO THE CAUSE.
016.2–5 / OAI-BH, one conference talk; no independent review · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
